positive_global_styles: original score for a stop-motion animated short film
piano, pizzicato strings, glockenspiel, soft brushed drums, light woodwinds
one clear memorable five-note motif heard first sad and slow in a minor key, later bright and quick in a major key
strong contrast between a weary first part and a joyful second part

one suspended high piano note held

one full beat of silence at the very start
then a clear modulation to a bright major key
the motif returns bright and lifted on piano with pizzicato strings
playful piano melody built on the motif
the big moment hits on the first beat
the fullest, widest statement of the motif in major
full strings, piano octaves, glockenspiel sparkle
one long warm final chord ringing out and fading
low minor motif interrupted twice by a quick high playful figure
